_doc: Per-variant economy. Every number is a hypothesis (design/EXPERIMENTS.md, design/model/pace_model.py); Step 06 tunes them with the real rules. cost(L) = round(base * growth^L) is the price of going from level L to L+1. A list (pops, batch, burst) gives what one action yields at level L and must rise strictly; it needs max_level + 1 entries. Times are milliseconds.

click._doc: A Click & Pop: one press = pops[L] popcorn = $pops[L].

perfect._doc: B Perfect Pop: hold to heat, release to pop. The gold window opens window_start_ms after the press and lasts window_ms + window_step_ms * L (at most window_max_ms); a release within near_ms of either edge is a near miss; an early release pays mult.early x held / window_start_ms (the heat reached); burn_after_ms after it closes the batch burns by itself. The batch pays batch[L] * the outcome's multiplier, at least $1.

explosion._doc: C Pop Explosion: each press drops a kernel into one of `slots`; a full chamber erupts for burst[L] popcorn = $burst[L] (paid when it erupts). The show lasts show_ms + show_step_ms * L (at most show_max_ms); presses during it fill the next chamber, which erupts when the show ends if it is full.

factory._doc: Step 16, the three-floor factory's hand kettle (design/FACTORY_FLOW.md): the stand's B numbers for now; Step 17 replaces paying on the pop with the conserved flow and moves the rest of the factory's numbers here.
factory._flow: Step 17 (design/FACTORY_FLOW.md): a release makes a lot of kettle_portions[level] x yield[grade] portions (at least 1) in the glass; the lift takes lift_ms to the bin (bin_portions); the packer takes pack.size portions per pack.ms onto the shelf (shelf_packs); customers arrive by a triangular wait (min_ms, mode_ms, max_ms; the first is waiting at the start, the second in second_ms), queue up to queue_cap, wait patience_ms; the counter hands a matching pack over in service_ms and only then earns price[recipe] x (0.6 + 0.4 x quality/100). Starting values, to be tuned by the simulator (Steps 22, 25).

auto_cooker._doc: Step 19: the basic auto cooker's numbers, the reference the hand is balanced against (Steps 26 and 28 build it): a lot every cycle_ms, of capacity_share x the kettle's portions, with these grade odds (it never judges perfect, never burns).
auto_cooker._doc_runtime: Step 25: the cooker runs in the model (Step 26 places it on screen). A cooker costs cost x growth^n for the n-th; while it works it pays upkeep_per_min coins, a whole coin at a time; with no coin to pay it pauses (never a debt) and resumes when a coin is there. Its lot goes up the lift when the bin has room for it, else it holds it (blocked, no upkeep). Opens with the sign's tier unlock_sign. max: the machine ceiling (Step 33: 60 -- 40 working at once with room to duplicate).
auto_cooker._doc_inputs: Step 28: a kettle holds kernel_buffer lots of kernels and uses one a cycle; with none it starves (refill by hand from the card at kernel_price a lot, or M01 the hopper buys and loads them). An oil dose (M02) costs oil_price.
auto_cooker._doc_portions: Step 25: a basic cooker is a basic machine -- capacity_share x 4 portions (a level-0 kettle), whatever the hand's kettle level (at kettle 8 one cooker used to cover the landmark's whole demand). Stronger machines are Steps 28-29.

crescendo._doc: Step 19: as the stand's (Step 14) -- a perfect pop adds 2 kernels, a near 1, misses nothing; the pop that fills 8 makes a lot of 1.5 x portions (real popcorn).

sizes._doc: Step 23, the bags customers can order: portions, price (plain, at quality 100), the packing tier that opens it, the share of orders once open (the rest order the small bag), and the stock the station keeps of it beyond the orders waiting (small bags fill the rest of the shelf).
Step 30: a cup of one portion, packed only by the cup feeder (P01) -- open while one runs.

fill._doc: Step 30: a volumetric filler (the bagger) overfills a pack by a portion this often (the extra portion is in the bag, not paid for); the portion weigher (P04) returns it to the bin.

pack_recipes._doc: Step 20: the SKU each recipe's popcorn is packed as (the seasoning of a later Step maps here); a pack never mixes recipes.

packer._doc: Step 20 (rebalanced in Step 24 so every tier relieves a bottleneck the shop reaches): a pack per head every ms (per_cycle heads), its look (0 scoop and paper bag, 1 bag feeder, 2 twin filling heads, 5 multihead packer); cost to reach the tier. Packs a minute 15, 20, 33, 75 -- just above what signs 3, 4, 5 and 6 bring (11, 17, 27, 40 customers a minute).

bargain._doc: Step 32, U05 the quality inspector: a lot below threshold quality becomes the bargain SKU (its own packs, price 7 at quality 100); while bargain popcorn is on hand, that share of new plain-wanting customers ask for a bargain; at most bin portions wait.

utility._doc: Step 32: below low_wallet coins the maintenance robot (U01) stops the helper machines first, so the machines that make and move goods keep running.

premium._doc: Step 29, M11 the quality sensor: a lot of quality >= threshold becomes the premium SKU (its own packs, price x1.2); while premium popcorn is on hand, that share of new customers ask for premium (only they buy it); with bin premium portions waiting, the sensor lets lots through as plain.

heat._doc: Step 29, the kitchen's heat: each cooking kettle adds per_kettle a second, the room loses dissipate (and fan more with M08); at limit, with min_kettles or more cooking and no vent stabilizer (M13), every kettle stops stop_ms to cool.

slots._doc: Step 26: machine places per floor (the kitchen's right side, the packing floor's back, the shop's front). Step 33 grows them toward 40.

lines._doc: Step 33: a floor's next lines of places, bought from the overview once every place on the floor holds a machine (the first line is `slots`). Two or more packing lines make parallel lines: a landing lot is routed to one line, a line's fillers pack only its goods (the station is the first line's), the route balancer U08 moves goods from a stopped line to an idle one. Full: kitchen 24, packing 12, shop 8 places (44, plus the distributors').

flavors._doc: Step 34, the flavor recipes (versioned data; design/STATIONS.md 5). Classic Butter is the base popcorn (`plain`: popped with butter in the kettle, no coating step). The others are coated on the packing floor by their machine (P05 the seasoning sprayer, P06 the coater): it takes `in` plain portions of its line from the bin, works coat_ms_per_portion x in (x its tier's ms_factor; the flavor base mixer M12 takes saved_ms off a batch, never below half), pays ingredient_coins at the start of a batch (the one money -- no second wallet; no coins, the batch waits, never a debt) and puts `out` portions of the flavor back on its line (out = in: coating adds taste, not portions -- nothing is lost or invented). A pack holds one flavor; packed stock never changes flavor. price: a small bag at quality 100 (sizes scale it like plain); quality_weight: how much quality moves the price (price x (1 - w + w x quality/100); plain 0.4); order_share: the share of new customers who ask for it while it is offered (a coater set to it works, or it is on hand; drawn once, only then -- a plain-only order stream is unchanged); patience: their patience multiplier (willingness to wait); stock: packs of it kept on the shelf beyond the orders (its place is kept from the plain stock); buffer: portions of a slow flavor kept coated in the bin besides (a large order is packed at once instead of waiting a whole batch at the head of the queue); unlock: the packing / sign tiers that open it. Version 2 (Step 35): the machine coats at its tier's auto_quality (x the popcorn's quality) and loses `loss` portions a portion to its drum (counted as lost, never vanished); the hand may finish a batch in the drum instead (hand_ms: the gold of the spoon's hold, per flavor -- see `hand`): perfect = hand_quality, near = near_quality, no loss, the batch done at the release; early or late changes nothing. mixes: a bag of two flavors half and half (orders only); promo: a flavor with a surplus is the board's special.

hand._doc: Step 35, the hand's finish (one optional action): once the hand has popped unlock_presses times, a coater's batch in the drum shows a spoon; holding it pours (the batch waits for the hand), releasing in the flavor's hand_ms (+ edge_grace_ms) finishes the batch at perfect_quality, within near_ms of it at near_quality (never below what the machine would give), with nothing lost and the batch done at once. Early or late: the batch goes on in the machine as before. Holding past drip_ms after the gold lets go by itself (late).

mixes._doc: Step 35: a mixed order -- one large bag, half of each part (portions of the parts' own flavors, packed together for that order only; never stock). Offered while both parts are offered and can meet on one packing line. price: as a small bag at quality 100 (sizes scale it).

promo._doc: Step 35, recovering from too much of a flavor: one that no working coater makes any more whose portions on hand (coated, packed) exceed what its orders, stock and buffer want by surplus_portions for after_ms is the board's special -- new customers ask for it share_mult times as often -- until the surplus is gone.

counter_machines._doc: Step 31: the storefront's machines. pay_share: the part of a hand-over that is paying (the auto cashier S03 takes it apart, one payment at a time); express: the express window's own lane (orders of at most max_size portions).

machines._doc: Step 26, the catalog of the other machines (the cooker's entry is auto_cooker). Each: cost x growth^n for the n-th, upkeep_per_min coins while it works (a coin at a time, never a debt), unlock (the packing tier / sign tier that opens it), tiers (cycle or service time, cost to reach).

counter._doc: Step 21: the counter's lanes -- packs handed over at once (the queue still goes in order). Step 24's shop tree adds lanes.

sign._doc: Step 22 (rebalanced in Step 24): each tier sets the next customer's wait -- triangular between min_ms and max_ms around mode_ms (mean (min+mode+max)/3), never a fixed timer -- and the shop's size (lanes, queue_cap). Means 15, 11, 8, 5.5, 3.5, 2.2, 1.5 s: about 4, 5.5, 7.5, 11, 17, 27, 40 customers a minute. The sign never makes money itself (STATIONS 3).

stand._doc: Step 10, the Popcorn Stand (design/SLICE.md): B's hold and release, plus shake (unlock.shake: `turns` direction changes in one heat = an even pop x shake.mult; the motor gives motor_mult to every batch and the hand's shake multiplies on top), recipes (unlock.recipes: mult x the batch, window_scale x the gold, burn_scale x the time from the gold to the burn, cooldown_add_ms after a pop), edge_grace_ms (a release this close outside the drawn gold still counts as perfect) and the automation ladder (unlock.auto: a motor that shakes every batch, then a helper kettle paying share x batch[L] every cycle_ms). costs: the main machine's prices, level by level -- B's first four, then stretched for a 10-20 minute session.

crescendo._doc: Step 14, a reversible mode (?burst=1): a perfect pop adds `perfect` kernels to the crescendo, a near pop `near`; nothing else adds or takes. The pop that fills it to `full` is a burst worth (1 + bonus) x its batch. `tiers`: the level from which the burst is a chain, then a fountain.
